node.title: Re: sending emails with attachements via gmail
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Several of the modules in [id://11112052|that thread] are by [https://metacpan.org/author/RJBS|RJBS], who has additional modules that can handle attachments, such as [mod://Email::Stuffer]. Untested, but try something like this instead of the [mod://Email::Simple] code in that thread:

Email::Stuffer ->from($smtp{user}) ->to($smtp{to}) ->subject($smtp{subject}) ->text_body($smtp{body}) ->attach_file('example.txt') ->transport($transport) ->send;
